body.purpose: All reading content: tables, forms, descriptions.

label.purpose: Table headers, status badges, form labels.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a screen (Save, Log Defect, Start Repair).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #DF4E4E; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B93A3A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(223,78,78,0.25); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1A1A1D; color: #F5F5F4; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #2A2A2E; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #6B6B72; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: The shared status vocabulary used for item status, defect severity, and defect status everywhere in the app.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge--good { background: rgba(52,211,153,0.16); color: #34D399; } .ds-badge--info { background: rgba(96,165,250,0.16); color: #60A5FA; } .ds-badge--caution { background: rgba(245,166,35,0.16); color: #F5A623; } .ds-badge--critical { background: rgba(223,78,78,0.16); color: #DF4E4E; } .ds-badge--neutral { background: rgba(113,113,122,0.16); color: #A3A3AC; }

components.name: Text Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="e.g. Main Hall Storage" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0A0A0B; color: #F5F5F4; border: 1px solid #2A2A2E; border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px 14px; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; width: 100%; transition: border-color 160ms, box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B6B72; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #DF4E4E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(223,78,78,0.25); }

components.name: Dashboard Widget Card
components.description: KPI widget card used on the Dashboard.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #121214; border: 1px solid #2A2A2E; border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; transition: border-color 160ms; } .ds-card-label { font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #A3A3AC; } .ds-card-value { font-family: Anton, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.2vw, 3.25rem); line-height: 1.02; color: #F5F5F4; }

narrative.overview: Picture the equipment store after everyone's gone home: shelves of sound and light gear sitting in the dark, each item's status catching a single point of red light — the one thing that needs your attention. That's the system. The canvas is committed black, not a tinted-dark dashboard gray — surfaces separate by subtle lightness steps and borders, never by drop shadow, because shadows don't read against true black. Anton carries the confidence: big, condensed, all-business headlines and KPI numbers that don't apologize for taking up space. Lato carries the warmth: everything a non-technical volunteer actually reads stays relaxed, legible, and plain-spoken. The accent red is spent deliberately: primary actions, the 'something needs attention' signal, and nowhere else.
keyCharacteristics: True-black canvas with tonal (not shadow-based) surface layering
One accent color, spent on purpose: primary actions + needs-attention states
Anton for structural confidence, Lato for everyday reading
A single shared badge vocabulary reused everywhere status appears
Generous touch targets and confirmation steps before anything consequential

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Red is the only saturated color with a subjective brand role. Every other color is a neutral gray-black step or a desaturated semantic color.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from surface lightness steps plus 1px borders, never from box-shadow blur.

rules.name: The Anton-Never-Reads Rule
rules.body: Anton is never used for body copy, table data, or button labels longer than 2-3 words.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadows appear only as a direct response to interaction state.

dos: Do keep the page canvas true black (#000000) — surfaces lift via tonal steps, never shadow.
Do reserve full-saturation Signal Red for primary actions and needs-attention semantics only.
Do use Anton exclusively for headlines and KPI numbers.
Do use the same status badge everywhere a given state appears.
Do require a confirmation step before Retire, Mark Not Repairable, or other consequential changes.
Do verify placeholder and muted text against true black — #6B6B72 is the lightness floor.
donts: Don't use the dated enterprise-ERP look.
Don't use a generic Bootstrap/AdminLTE admin-template visual language.
Don't tip into a playful consumer-app register.
Don't apply drop-shadow blur to cards or panels at rest.
Don't use border-left/right color stripes as a status or nav-active indicator.
Don't add a second saturated accent color alongside Signal Red.
Don't set body or label text lighter/grayer than #6B6B72.
